cases.study_information: Rank all ten IL-17A/F IgG1-YTE antibodies from highest to lowest terminal half-life after SC dosing in cynomolgus monkeys. Matched IV half-lives, human binding and functional results are visible. The experiment used a single 50 mg/kg dose, four animals per group and sampling through day 49. The reference antibody had IV/SC half-lives of 9.2/9.8 days. Predict the observed route-dependent outcome; target SC values are withheld and true experimental ties are retained in organizer scoring.
